title: Whether each of the ten new language versions of a survey's twelve-item connectedness scale is released for fieldwork, held for a second pilot or sent back for retranslation, each judged on the share of its pilot score's variance due to the trait
subdomain: psychometric-measurement-scale-validation (a university survey research centre's release gate for the new language versions of a survey scale)
prompt_shape: 07: a grid of cells, ten language versions each with its release decision, its valid pilot completes and its pilot mean score, and a chart of each version against the release bands (37 criteria)

sources.origin: generated by task237/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a university survey research centre's translation register, translation and adaptation standard and technical manual, and two fieldwork vendors' pilot files; the centre, the survey, the scale, the vendors and the people are invented, and no real respondent is depicted.
